title: Admission Forgot Password
query: I can't remember the password for the admissions website. What now?

en: If you forgot or need to reset your BukSU Admission portal password, go to https://admissions.buksu.edu.ph/login.
Click the Forgot Password option on the login page.
Enter the email address registered to your BukSU Admission account and follow the instructions sent to your email.
ceb: Kung nakalimot ka o kinahanglan nimo i-reset ang imong BukSU Admission portal password, adto sa https://admissions.buksu.edu.ph/login.
I-click ang Forgot Password option sa login page.
Ibutang ang email address nga naka-register sa imong BukSU Admission account ug sunda ang instructions nga ipadala sa imong email.

answer: To change your admission password, follow these steps: Go to https://admissions.buksu.edu.ph/login Login your credentials and proceed to your dashboard click your Profile icon to view the choices logout or My Account, and choose My Account you can now change your password by just clicking the Change Password button
